rows.en: But to make this Cube mine, you lot were a thorn in my side.
So I rounded up Imagin and Dopants.
After I lost at the Colosseum, I ran into this man here, see.
And that's when he let me in on his plan to take you guys down.
That's right. And now I've struck this one down.
Something this fun? No way I wasn't gonna get in on it! Hahaha!
Now... this is the end. Be devoured by me!
Tch... Failed again this time, huh... Next time for sure... I'll devour you all...
As Gaoh was destroyed, the Imagin and Dopants he had gathered scattered and fled.
That was close, but that's the job done.
Yeah! Ya got that right!
Yeah! You're right!
Yeah! You're right!

Yes! You're right!

...Hold it. What's that?
Obtained "Ultra Bracelet".
Obtained "GN Drive Tau".
Obtained "Kujaku Candroid".
Looks like this is the treasure Gaoh was hoarding. Perfect. We'll put it to good use.
Completed the quest "The Evil Grand Bandit Gang Returns!".
The supposedly defeated Mezool and Gamel were sighted. Take OOO to SW Ultra Cube Layer 2.
If I remember right, the report said it was around here.
Oh my? Isn't that Ankh? And OOO, that little boy?
They came! Ankh and OOO, they came!
Gamel! Mezool!! So you really did come back!!
What's going on!? We definitely beat them back then...
I'm the one who brought them back.
Uva...! What are you playing at!!
After I lost the Regis Fight...
I secretly used Waste Yummies to make Cell Medals and built up my strength,
then used the Core Medals I'd collected to revive Mezool and Gamel...
All so I could be sure of taking your Core Medals!!
Now then, little OOO boy. I'll be taking those Medals back.
Medals make Mezool happy. I take Medals.
Tch. Pretty clever thinking, for Uva.
OOO!! Let's go!
Yeah, I know!
Ugh...!! No way... This can't be...!!
What's wrong, Uva? For all your big talk, that was over pretty fast, huh?
...I won't forget this.
Tch!
You sure about this, Ankh? Just letting him go like that?
Don't worry. He's got no power left.
Completed the quest "Return of the Greeed".
